blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippines women’s football team will look to formally secure its place in the quarterfinals of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 on Monday despite a tall order at hand against China. Kickoff is at 3 p.m. at Gifu Nagaragawa Stadium, where the Filipinas seek a favorable result regardless of the outcome against the fancied Chinese side. At least a draw will send coach Mark Torcaso’s side to the quarterfinals, but a loss can still be enough for the team to get out of the group either as a […]...
